dedupe_keys.name: brainport urban driving route request vru detection

description: AUTOPILOT project partners publish urban-driving sessions linking taxi requests, crowd-aware route choice and vulnerable-road-user detection. Test variants include fixed routes, one or several smartphone-carrying pedestrians, camera-only baselines and geofencing enabled or disabled. One description uses a 20 by 50 metre detection area; that is a scenario parameter, not overall dataset coverage. Vehicle records, GPS, smartphone status, arrival-time messages, crowd-estimation messages and taxi requests are described. Rerouting and rebalancing are bounded demonstrated scenarios, with identifiers and run-specific pedestrian patterns preserved in the source metadata. Neither successful receipt of a warning nor the number of smartphones establishes detector accuracy or deployment safety. The related Brainport highway, parking and platooning records have different test purposes and must not be treated as identical samples. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
